releaseNotes:
- Separates sandbox residency, per-sandbox task concurrency, preparation and
  cleanup limits, with API sublimits inside the shared system capacity
- Preserves completed peers' workspace changes when another task fails to
  start; awaits checkpoint completion before sandbox stop and blocks unsafe
  hydration after a failed save, including across service restart
- Bounds streaming buffers and coalesces persisted text updates; moves SQLite
  checkpoints off the request thread and awaits worker exit during store close
- Reconciles native Harness cancellation and shared-sandbox cleanup without
  stopping other tasks or silently replaying failed operations
- Uses Runtime `1.0.0-beta.20`, including the macOS VZ socket ownership fix and
  preinstalled Python, pip and venv in local images; Node, Codex and OpenCode
  remain prebuilt, and the local default remains 2 vCPUs / 2048 MiB
- Retains provider-owned Cube base templates and materializes the matching
  AgentOS runtime from the administrator-selected exact base template ID

### Verification

- Release source passed type checks, production build and all 706 tests;
  final versioned artifact acceptance is required before upload
- Local candidate passed real Codex/OpenCode Python execution, four sandboxes
  with three tasks each, graceful shutdown, database integrity and restart
  continuation with all checked workspace outputs preserved
